scientific_hypothesis: The remaining zero-candidate case is not caused by query-count limits or exact duplicate response signatures. It may require candidates defined by compositional relations among query responses. A deterministic closure system built from label-free implication and equivalence relations over allowed-row response vectors can expose structurally redundant remaining-query sets that neither seeded sampling nor exact-signature grouping can generate.

single_allowed_algorithmic_change.name: response_lattice_closure_generator
single_allowed_algorithmic_change.description: For each allowed-row set, represent every compiled query by its Boolean response vector. Construct a finite closure system using only exact structural relations: equivalence q_i=q_j, implication q_i=>q_j, incompatibility q_i AND q_j=0, and deterministic intersections of implication-closed generator sets. Emit remaining-query masks only from nontrivial closed sets and their deterministic minimal generators. Rank candidates by a SHA-256 digest of task shape, allowed mask, closed mask, and generator mask.
single_allowed_algorithmic_change.activation: Only when the unchanged v0.84 selector returns zero states.

negative_result_policy: Every failed synthetic invariant, coverage gate, correctness gate, or performance threshold is retained permanently. No threshold or relation definition may be weakened after inspecting opened-data results.
claim_boundary: This is a preregistered opened-data development hypothesis. Passing it would not constitute untouched external validation, independent reproduction, a world-class result, or a general-AI breakthrough.
